Vendored from crates.io `gpui-base` 0.8.1 (longbridge/gpui-kit commit `99576db58ec8103417c41a092e891b4022d24e7e`, `crates/base`). The list body retains its intrinsic flex basis so content-sized containers include its text width. The accompanying TextView tests cover short lists and constrained wrapping; desktop conversation tests cover the application with native macOS fonts. Upstream: https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3759.
